name: Takama Asuka
source: [url=/c17980]Reiko[/url]'s older sister. Because she was tired of her strict father trying to control her and her sister's life, she left home with little more than her bike and some clothes. Asuka and the protagonist meet by chance when he saved her from an aggressor.
